title: Notion — Block Editor
description: Nested vertical slice (slice-of-slices) porting the notion-page-clone block editor as rr's rich-text content engine. Cluster-private shared layer under @notion/* (vendored block/page model, uid, inline markdown). WIP: milestone 1 ships the decoupled pure core (block specs + block-tree/turn-into/markdown-triggers/inline-decorator/synced/layout utils, 151 tests). Components + convex + the EditorAdapter cross-slice seam land in later milestones.
